findings.title: Microsoft says KB5120998 Windows update resets desktop settings
findings.summary_md: Microsoft confirmed that desktop settings are lost or reset on some Windows devices after installing the KB5120998 August 2026 preview update. The issue affects Windows 11 24H2 and 25H2 and can reset wallpaper, themes, and other desktop settings, with affected systems showing a solid black background that cannot be restored manually. Microsoft said the problem was documented in a Windows release health update on September 3, 2026.

findings.title: Desktop background settings are lost or reset on some devices (Windows 11 25H2)
findings.summary_md: Microsoft opened a known issue stating that after installing Windows updates released August 27, 2026 (KB5120998), some Windows Desktop settings fail to load and backgrounds display as a solid black color. The issue was opened on September 2, 2026 at 18:29 PT and resolved by updates released September 8, 2026 (KB5124008). Affected platforms were Windows 11 25H2 and 24H2.
